verdict.rationale: A government digital-administration portal could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so this question applies to ANEF. The evidence shows only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell behind account login, and a Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site. Nothing documents any API, API versioning, or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
